how_this_works.heading: How it works
how_this_works.subtitle: A quick guide to browsing and reserving from the Activist Resource Library.

browse.title: Browse the inventory
browse.body: Use the Equipment, Books, Rooms, and Expertise filters to find what you need. Each equipment, book, and room card shows whether an item is available today, needs a closer look on the calendar, or is already reserved.

account.title: Create a member account
account.body: Register with your email and password, then read and agree to the member agreement. You need an account before you can submit a reservation request.

reserve.title: Pick your dates
reserve.body: Click Reserve Inventory on an item to open the calendar. Equipment and books reserve in fixed Tuesday blocks (one week or one month). Rooms use a flexible date range. For expertise, click Request Consultation and share 2-3 time slots you're available plus a summary of what you'd like help with.

approval.title: Wait for confirmation
approval.body: Your request is submitted as pending. Apathy is Boring reviews it and emails you when it is approved or declined. Pending dates are held on the calendar until a decision is made.

pickup.title: Pick up and return
pickup.body: For equipment and books, pickup and drop-off are on Tuesdays between 10am and 5pm at the Apathy is Boring office. Return items on time so other members can use them. Expertise consultations happen on Zoom — the link is in your invitation email and on your account page, no pickup needed.

faq.question: Do I need an account to reserve inventory?
faq.answer: Yes. You must register with your email and password, agree to the member agreement, and sign in before you can submit a reservation request.

faq.question: What happens after I submit a reservation?
faq.answer: Your request is saved as pending. Apathy is Boring reviews it and emails you when it is approved or declined. Pending dates are held on the calendar until a decision is made.

faq.question: How do equipment and book reservations work?
faq.answer: Equipment reserves in a one-week block starting on a Tuesday (through the following Tuesday). Books reserve in a one-month block starting on a Tuesday (four weeks later). Only Tuesdays are selectable on the calendar.

faq.question: Can I choose any dates for rooms?
faq.answer: Yes. Room reservations use a flexible inclusive date range — click a start date and an end date on the calendar, subject to availability.

faq.question: How do expertise consultations work?
faq.answer: Click Request Consultation on an expertise item, then share 2-3 time slots you're available and a summary of what you'd like expertise about. The expert gets your request by email, picks a meeting time from your slots, and you both receive a Zoom invitation. Either of you can cancel from the account page, and the other person is notified.

faq.question: Can I share my own expertise?
faq.answer: Yes. From your account page, Share Expertise lets you publish one mentor profile. It appears on the Expertise list. When the mentor email matches your account email, you can edit that profile from the same page.

faq.question: Where do I pick up and return items?
faq.answer: Equipment and books are picked up and returned at the Apathy is Boring office in Montreal on Tuesdays between 10am and 5pm.

faq.question: What do the availability badges mean?
faq.answer: Available means the item is not reserved today. Unavailable means it is currently reserved. Check availability means it is not reserved today but has no bookable window within the next seven days.

faq.question: How many pending reservations can I have?
faq.answer: You can have up to five pending reservation requests at a time. Submit more after Apathy is Boring approves or declines your existing requests.

faq.question: Is the library only for Montreal?
faq.answer: The Activist Resource Library serves organizers across Canada. Inventory is based in Montreal, but members from anywhere in Canada can browse online and request reservations.

about.heading: About the Activist Resource Library
about.subtitle: A shared lending library for organizers, educators, and community groups across Canada.
about.mission_body: The Activist Resource Library makes equipment, books, and meeting space available to people doing grassroots organizing, civic education, and community work. By sharing resources, we help movements stretch limited budgets and get tools into the hands of people who need them.
about.canada_body: Although pickup is based in Montreal, the library is built for a Canada-wide community. Members anywhere in the country can browse inventory online, create a free account, and request reservations. Our goal is to lower barriers to participation in democracy and social change from coast to coast to coast.
about.partners_intro: The Activist Resource Library is a collaboration between organizations committed to youth engagement and democratic participation.
about.partner_aib_body: Apathy is Boring is a national non-partisan charitable organization that supports youth engagement and participation in Canada's democracy. AisB operates the library, reviews reservation requests, and hosts pickup in Montreal.
about.partner_fes_body: FES supports projects that strengthen democratic culture and civic participation. FES partnered with Apathy is Boring to help launch and sustain the Activist Resource Library.
about.contact_intro: Questions about the library, partnerships, or reservations? Send us a message and we'll get back to you.
